test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Fredrick had submitted all the pending assignments by Wednesday.

options.text: Fredrick was submitting all the pending assignments by Wednesday.
All the pending assignments are to be submitted by Fredrick by Wednesday.
All the pending assignments had been submitted by Fredrick by Wednesday.
All the pending assignments are being submitted by Fredrick by Wednesday.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct option** that expresses the given sentence in the passive voice is **3)** All the pending assignments had been submitted by Fredrick by Wednesday.
 
• The **original sentence** is in the** active voice**, with Fredrick as the subject performing the action of submitting the pending assignments.
 
• **To convert **it to **passive voice**, we need to make the pending assignments the subject of the sentence and indicate that they are receiving the action.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *All the pending assignments had been submitted by Fredrick by Wednesday.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) **"Fredrick was submitting all the pending assignments by Wednesday" is in the past continuous tense and does not reflect the passive voice.
 
• **Option 2) **"All the pending assignments are to be submitted by Fredrick by Wednesday" is in the future passive voice, indicating that the assignments need to be submitted by a certain time.
 
• **Option 4)** "All the pending assignments are being submitted by Fredrick by Wednesday" is in the present continuous tense and does not reflect the past action mentioned in the original sentence.
